# Site index models included in the package

```{r}
#| label: si-model-sections
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| results: asis

plot_si_curves <- function(
  model,
  si_values = c(5, 10, 15, 20, 25),
  age_min = 1,
  age_max = 150,
  age_by = 1,
  subregion = "All",
  fixed_args = NULL,
  facet_ncol = 4
) {
  if (is.function(model)) {
    model_fun <- model
    model_name <- as.character(substitute(model))
  } else if (is.character(model) && length(model) == 1L) {
    model_name <- model
    model_fun <- get(model_name, mode = "function")
  } else {
    stop("`model` must be a function or function name.")
  }

  reg <- CanadaForestAllometry:::si_model_registry_species()
  reg_match <- reg |>
    dplyr::filter(.data$engine == model_name)

  if (nrow(reg_match) == 0L) {
    stop(sprintf("No SI registry entry found for `%s`.", model_name))
  }

  row_use <- reg_match[1, , drop = FALSE]

  species_vec <- unlist(row_use$species[[1]], use.names = FALSE)
  age_basis <- row_use$age_basis[[1]]
  x_axis_label <- switch(
    age_basis,
    total_age = "Total age (years)",
    breast_height_age = "Breast-height age (years)",
    "Age (years)"
  )

  if (!isTRUE(row_use$supports_predict_height[[1]])) {
    p <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
      ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = "Height curve not available for this model") +
      ggplot2::xlim(0, 1) +
      ggplot2::ylim(0, 1) +
      ggplot2::theme_void() +
      ggplot2::ggtitle(paste0(model_name, "()"))
    return(list(plot = p, n_rows = 1L, n_species = 0L))
  }

  row_fixed <- row_use$fixed_args[[1]]
  if (is.null(row_fixed)) row_fixed <- list()
  if (is.null(fixed_args)) fixed_args <- list()
  call_fixed <- utils::modifyList(row_fixed, fixed_args)

  ages <- seq(age_min, age_max, by = age_by)
  grid <- tidyr::expand_grid(
    species = species_vec,
    si = si_values,
    age = ages
  )

  pred_one <- function(age_i, si_i, sp_i) {
    args <- c(
      list(age = age_i, si = si_i),
      if ("species" %in% names(formals(model_fun))) list(species = sp_i) else list(),
      if ("subregion" %in% names(formals(model_fun))) list(subregion = subregion) else list(),
      call_fixed
    )
    out <- tryCatch(do.call(model_fun, args), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(out) || !"height" %in% names(out)) return(NA_real_)
    as.numeric(out$height[[1]])
  }

  grid$height <- vapply(
    seq_len(nrow(grid)),
    function(i) pred_one(grid$age[[i]], grid$si[[i]], grid$species[[i]]),
    numeric(1)
  )

  plot_data <- grid |>
    dplyr::filter(is.finite(.data$height)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(si = factor(.data$si, levels = sort(unique(si_values))))

  label_data <- plot_data |>
    dplyr::group_by(.data$species, .data$si) |>
    dplyr::filter(.data$age == max(.data$age, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
    dplyr::slice_tail(n = 1) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()

  n_species <- length(species_vec)
  n_rows <- max(1L, ceiling(n_species / facet_ncol))
  n_panels <- n_rows * facet_ncol

  species_plots <- lapply(species_vec, function(sp) {
    df_sp <- plot_data |>
      dplyr::filter(.data$species == sp)
    lab_sp <- label_data |>
      dplyr::filter(.data$species == sp)

    ggplot2::ggplot(
      df_sp,
      ggplot2::aes(x = .data$age, y = .data$height, group = .data$si)
    ) +
      ggplot2::geom_line(linewidth = 0.6, color = "black") +
      ggplot2::geom_text(
        data = lab_sp,
        ggplot2::aes(label = .data$si),
        size = 2.2,
        hjust = -0.15,
        color = "black"
      ) +
      ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
        limits = c(0, age_max),
        breaks = seq(0, age_max, by = 25),
        expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))
      ) +
      ggplot2::labs(
        title = sp,
        x = x_axis_label,
        y = "Top height (m)"
      ) +
      ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 10)
  })

  if (n_panels > n_species) {
    species_plots <- c(
      species_plots,
      replicate(n_panels - n_species, patchwork::plot_spacer(), simplify = FALSE)
    )
  }

  p <- patchwork::wrap_plots(species_plots, ncol = facet_ncol)

  list(plot = p, n_rows = n_rows, n_species = n_species)
}

reg <- CanadaForestAllometry:::si_model_registry_species() |>
  dplyr::arrange(model_id)

reg_fun <- reg |>
  dplyr::group_by(engine) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    rank = max(rank, na.rm = TRUE),
    description = dplyr::first(description),
    reference = dplyr::first(reference),
    age_basis = dplyr::first(age_basis),
    province_scope = list(sort(unique(unlist(province_scope)))),
    species = list(sort(unique(unlist(species)))),
    supports_predict_height = any(supports_predict_height),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(engine)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(reg_fun))) {
  x <- reg_fun[i, , drop = FALSE]

  coverage <- if (any(x$province_scope[[1]] == "ALL")) {
    "Canada (all provinces/territories)"
  } else {
    paste(x$province_scope[[1]], collapse = ", ")
  }

  species_cov <- if (length(x$species[[1]]) == 0L) {
    "unknown"
  } else {
    paste(x$species[[1]], collapse = ", ")
  }

  age_basis_text <- switch(
    x$age_basis[[1]],
    total_age = "Total age",
    breast_height_age = "Breast-height age",
    x$age_basis[[1]]
  )

  description_text <- paste(
    sub("\\.*\\s*$", "", x$description[[1]]),
    x$reference[[1]]
  )

  ref_fun_link <- paste0(
    "[`", x$engine, "()`](../reference/", x$engine, ".html)"
  )

  cat("## `", x$engine, "()`\n\n", sep = "")
  cat("- Function reference: ", ref_fun_link, "\n", sep = "")
  cat("- Description: ", description_text, "\n", sep = "")
  cat("- Age type: ", age_basis_text, "\n", sep = "")
  cat("- Coverage: ", coverage, "\n", sep = "")
  cat("- Species coverage: ", species_cov, "\n", sep = "")
  cat("\n", sep = "")

  if (identical(x$engine[[1]], "si_nigh2000_gi")) {
    cat("_No curve graphic shown for growth-intercept model._\n\n")
    cat("\n\n")
    next
  }

  plot_out <- plot_si_curves(
    model = x$engine,
    si_values = c(5, 10, 15, 20, 25),
    age_min = 1,
    age_max = 150,
    age_by = 1,
    subregion = "All",
    facet_ncol = 4
  )

  p <- plot_out$plot +
    patchwork::plot_annotation(title = paste0(x$engine, "()"))

  fig_dir <- knitr::opts_chunk$get("fig.path")
  dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  file_stub <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_-]", "-", x$engine)
  fig_file <- file.path(fig_dir, paste0("si-curves-", file_stub, ".png"))
  fig_file_out <- gsub("\\\\", "/", fig_file)

  row_height <- 2.3
  fig_h <- max(2.8, row_height * plot_out$n_rows)

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = fig_file,
    plot = p,
    width = 10,
    height = fig_h,
    dpi = 140,
    bg = "white"
  )

  cat("![](", fig_file_out, ")\n\n", sep = "")
  cat("\n\n")
}
```
